response.overview: Joey is a former boxer with a winning streak in MMA (mixed martial arts).  In his pursuit of becoming a professional fighter, he accepts an illegal job that offers him the freedom to train MMA full-time.  Despite his best intentions, Joey is led deeper into the criminal underworld, forcing him to control his rage, confront his troubled past and prove to himself that he is nothing like his violent father.  Will his new career, grant him his wishes of becoming a professional cage fighter? Or will it lead him down a path of grave danger and self-destruction?
response.title: Cage Rage
